newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Telemig 1996 net profit higher.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Telemig 1996 net profit higher.

text.p: Brazil's Telemig, unit of federally owned Telebras serving Minas Gerais state, said it reported a net profit of 254.2 million reais in 1996, an increase of 230 percent over 1995.
Telemig's 1996 earnings were the best results in the firm's history, Telemig president Saulo Coelho told reporters.
The company's gross operating revenues rose 63 percent to 1.4 billion reais in 1996, he said.
Telemig closed the year with 1.488 million conventional telephone lines and 233,042 cellular lines installed.
It plans to install 260,000 conventional lines and 195,000 cellular lines in 1997.
Telemig also noted its preferred stock rose 189 percent in 1996, while its common stock gained 158 percent in the period.
